capabilities.name: Automated cell segmentation

capabilities.name: Fragmented junction analysis
capabilities.notes: JM paper highlights this as unique capability; EPG measures cluster_count, cluster_density

capabilities.name: Junction morphology classification
capabilities.description: Automatic classification of junction types (straight, thick, reticular, etc.)
capabilities.notes: EndoPiGraph: heuristic + ML classifier; JM: manual phenotype assignment

capabilities.name: Multi-junction type support
capabilities.description: Simultaneous analysis of AJ, TJ, GJ markers
capabilities.notes: EndoPiGraph builds typed pi-graphs with multiple marker types

capabilities.name: Corner/vertex detection
capabilities.notes: JM auto-detects corners; EPG detects via graph triangles

capabilities.name: Network/graph analysis
capabilities.description: Graph-based analysis of cell contact network topology
capabilities.notes: EndoPiGraph: full NetworkX graph with clustering, degree, etc.

capabilities.name: Batch processing

capabilities.notes: EndoPiGraph: fully automated batches; JM: manual per-image

capabilities.name: Skeleton-based morphometry

capabilities.name: Multiple cell types
capabilities.notes: JM validated on epithelial, cardiomyocytes, endothelial
